grammar_tips.title: Interpreting Figurative Language
grammar_tips.explanation: Look for meanings beyond the literal words. Example: 'Time is a thief' does not mean time steals literally.

grammar_tips.title: Identifying Similes and Metaphors
grammar_tips.explanation: Similes use 'like' or 'as'; metaphors do not. Example: 'She is as brave as a lion' (simile). 'She is a lion' (metaphor).

example_sentences.sentence: His words cut deeper than a knife. (Metaphor)
The wind whispered through the trees. (Personification)
Boom! The fireworks exploded in the sky. (Onomatopoeia)
